about: Curated inventory of the non-Cargo components in VA Studio, read by generate-third-party-notices.py. Cargo crates come from the lockfiles, not from this file. 'path' is relative to the source root. 'license_files' are relative to 'path', or to the source root when they start with '@/'. 'inputs' (root-relative) are the patches and manifests that define a modified external build input. A component whose license files cannot be found is reported as incomplete.
